CASTING BUSINESSMEN FOR SENIOR
THESIS SHORT FILM!

Hello, my name is Elliot Harrington and I am the producer of the upcoming short film called “Sponsored By”. It is about a divorced father who takes on coaching a Little League baseball team in hopes to impress his boss, get a promotion, and be invited to an exclusive BBQ.

Looking for:
- Individuals to play businessmen. Must read as 30-50 years of age

Shooting Dates:
- October 3rd: 8 AM-6 PM
- October 4th: 8 AM-6 PM

Shooting Location: Loveland, CO

Businessmen are unpaid, but will receive IMDb credit. You must be ok with sitting around and waiting. Unfortunately, that’s the majority of what the businessmen will be doing.

If you are interested, or know anyone who is interested, please reach out to me with your availability and your headshot. You can message me here or email me @ elliot.m.harrington@gmail.com

Thank you!

items.text:
Room to Become — Paid Casting Overview
Project type

Commercial / branded short film. ~60-second hero spot with :30, :15, and :06 cutdowns, shot in 16:9 and 9:16 for paid media, social, connected TV, and web.

Project description

A 60-second brand film for a national student housing company, set in a single apartment over the course of a school year, with limited dialogue.

The story follows a college student through the everyday moments of living on their own with roommates. Over the year, an empty apartment becomes a home, and the student grows into a more confident version of themselves.

The tone is grounded, observational, and warm. We want naturalistic performers who can carry a scene with small, true behavior (a pause, a look, a laugh that runs too long) instead of big acting.

Roles

The Student (Lead) — Plays 18–24, any gender or ethnicity. On screen throughout. Grows from a guarded newcomer into the heart of the household over the year. Needs strong stillness and the ability to play a lot without words. Some dialogue.

The Roommate (Supporting) — Plays 18–24, any gender or ethnicity. Starts as a stranger and becomes a close friend. A quiet, steady presence. Light dialogue.

Friends (Featured, 2) — Plays 18–24. Part of the Student's growing circle, appearing across several scenes. Physical comedy and improv a plus.

All performers must be 18 or older. We're especially interested in hearing from local college film and theatre students.

Self-tape instructions

All roles use the same self-tape. Tell us which role(s) you're interested in, and we'll cast from what we see. Keep it natural, and keep the whole tape under a minute. Phones are fine.

Slate (about 10 sec): Your name, city, confirmation that you're 18 or older, and your availability for the shoot date.

Quiet call (10–15 sec): You've had a rough day and you call home, but you don't want them to worry. Play only your side of the call.

"Hey. No, nothing's wrong, I just hadn't talked to you in a couple days. … Yeah. It's good. It's fine. … No. I'm good. Love you too."

Loud call (about 10 sec): Months later, you call the same person with great news from a packed room.

"I did it — I actually did it! … Come over. To my place. Come celebrate."

Send self tapes and any previous content you'd like reviewed to Ryan.Sundling@AgencyFIFTY3.com.

Union status

Non-union.

Compensation

Paid. Flat rate per role, which includes the shoot day and a usage buyout in perpetuity (all media: paid, social, web, and connected TV). Meals provided on set.

The Student: $350

The Roommate: $250

Friends: $200 each

Key dates & locations

Submissions and self-tapes due: October 8

Shoot: TBD, one day between October 13 and 21. The Student and Roommate are needed for the full day (up to 10 hours, including a meal break); the Friends for about three-quarters of the day.

Location: TBD, in the Denver metro area. One apartment interior. Local hire only; no travel or lodging provided.

items.text:
Two rejects in one night 😪 Trying hard to find my next exciting opportunities. I guess at least these got back to me. Waiting to hear from one more.  Anyway I bought a longer backdrop screen and a dummy head so i have something to look at for auditions.  Dispite the setbacks I am growing and learning every day.  
I returned to the industry in May. I have taken part in four TV, film and music video projects. Two with speaking roles, two as a featured Supporting Artist. I now have two IMDb credits with a third on its way. I have an IMDb and Spotlight profile. All i need now is my professional show reel.  Not a bad start for my return after a long break.  
Picking myself back up and moving forward. 😌

topComments.text: Well done and good luck with everything x
It's so disheartening to get multiple rejections on one day but mourn, then let tomorrow bring new possibilities.

CASTING CALL - AUDIO SERIES
We are in need of males and females from across the UK to voice a characters in our “on the Coaches” series.

Please be aware some of these roles are regular (most episodes) and some are one off’s (but there will be other roles)

📣ALL ROLES ARE VOLUNTARY📣

⏰PLEASE ONLY GET IN TOUCH IF YOU HAVE TIME FOR THE PROJECT

All ages welcome (some roles are age and gender specific)

The series is similar to “On the buses” type of comedy (its more modern and more acceptable humour compared to theirs lol) But we do still have some very risqué gags and on the nose humour - this project is not for the faint hearted so if easily offended then please bare that in mind before submitting show reels etc.

If you are interested in joining our team then please drop us a message ideally. Any negative comments will be removed. We are doing this project for the fun and enjoyment of what we do - we do not need any trolls or haters trying to destroy something a lot of us are passionate about.

ROLES & SPECIFICS BELOW

MAIN CHARACTER - MUST BE FROM UK

MALE (MID 20s)

Personality: Jack the lad type, thinks he's a bit of a ladies man, always up for a laugh and full of inappropriate “dad” jokes.

Bio: Looked up to his bus driver grandad who passed away when he was young, he always told him stories about his time on the buses which led him to work on the coaches because he had to go bigger and better to make his late grandad proud! Always up for a laugh and extremely flirty with everyone (male and female - he’s unconfirmed Bi)

MAIN CHARACTER

FEMALE (LATE 20s)

Personality: Strong willed lesbian who wont take any crap. Very masculine energy and hates and happily insults anyone that treats her like a typical woman.

Bio: Despite being a card carrying lesbian you wouldn't know to look at her and many men do much to the annoyance of her partner who also works at the depot. 

SUPPORTING/ONE OFF

MALE

20-70 years old

Must be from UK 

Various one off characters OR smaller role reoccuring characters 

FEMALE

20-70 years old

Must be from UK 

Various one off characters OR smaller role reoccuring characters 

We look forward to hopefully working with you and welcoming you to the Fandio & On The Coaches family!

## Models/Statisten (w/m/d) für ein Fotoshooting: "Schule in Zeiten der Digitalisierung" gesucht
## 

*****ENGLISH BELOW*****

Wir suchen eine vielfältige Gruppe junger Models im Alter von 16 bis 17 Jahren (du musst die 10. Klasse abgeschlossen haben).

**Allgemeine Informationen:**
**Datum:** 10. October 2026
**Zeit:** 15:00-20:00
**Ort/Adresse:** Berlin-Bezirk Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf
**Thema:** Schule in Zeiten der Digitalisierung
**Gage:** 120 € durch Paypal oder Banküberweisung

Auftraggeber ist eine schwedische Bildagentur www.maskot.se

Erfahrung nicht erforderlich, solange Sie glücklich und selbstbewusst vor der Kamera sind.
Leider können wir uns nur dann bei Ihnen melden, wenn der Kunde Sie auswählt – deshalb möchten wir Ihnen schon im Voraus für Ihre Bewerbung danken!

****************************************************************

We are looking for a diverse group of young models between the age of 16-17 (you have to have finished the 10th class of school)

**General information:**

**Date:** 10th of October 2026
**Time:** 15:00-20:00
**Location/Address:** Berlin-Bezirk Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf
**Theme:** School in the Age of Digitalisation
**Fee:** 120 € through paypal or bank transfer

The client is a Swedish stock photo agency www.maskot.se

Experience is not required as long as you are happy and confident in front of the camera. Unfortunately, unless the client selects you, we will not be able to get back to you – we want to thank you in advance for your application!

**Former UGC Creator Transitioning to Acting – Ready to Jump In! 🎭**

Hi everyone!

I’m 31 and finally taking the leap into acting. I’ve spent the past few years working as a content and UGC creator, but I’ve realized it’s just not fulfilling the creative itch I have. I’m ready to pour my energy into work that actually brings me joy.

A bit about my background:
* **On-Camera Experience:** Very comfortable on mic/camera from years of short-form content and UGC production.
* **Roots:** Grew up writing, making, and acting in indie short films with my brother.
* **Vocals:** I’m a singer and released an original track across all streaming platforms a few years ago.
* **Current Focus:** Lately I've been filming tons of monologues and self-tapes to sharpen my skills, but I'm eager to get out there and start working on real projects asap!

*(Side note: I know these attached photos aren't professional headshots, just a few pictures where I was playing with lighting a bit! I'm not here to offend anyone, just genuinely looking for advice, guidance, and networking opportunities.)*

I’d love to connect—open to student projects, indie shorts, or collaborative work to help build a proper acting reel. Feel free to drop a line below or message me directly!

items.text:
Casting call- Generating Jade (unpaid)
Heya hope you are all well, we are looking for three female actors for our short film.

Generating Jade follows a grieving sister (Rose) using a company which specialises in an Generative Ai that can recreate a simulation of memories to relieve memories of her sister Jade. But when some memories appear different when they once were Rose is left with a choice. 

Roles

Rose- female early twenties 

Rose throughout the story is desperate to relive memories of her sister but struggles when the memories aren't correct. Needs to be able to act through emotional scenes 

Jade/Ai Jade- female, early twenties

Jade is roses sister which throught the story switches between a chill and laid back nature to an ai bot almost like siri or  Alexa.

Dr Isla Evans- female, twenty and above

Dr isla Evans throughout the story acts like a mix of a doctor and like a salesperson, trying to push Rose to keep using the simulation.

We are looking into filming end of October/ start of November but dated are yet to be confirmed. 

Would be filmed in Manchester

If interested please either Dm or email

C.killian@edu.salford.ac.uk

SPRING / SUMMER 2026 — CAPE TOWN

A.L.T. is casting female bikini models for an ongoing summer beach photoshoot project starting in October.

Experienced and first-time models are welcome.

PROJECT DETAILS
• Cape Town beach locations
• Shoot days scheduled according to weather & production requirements
• Typically 1–2 shoot days per week, with some weeks skipped
• Approx. 3–5 hours per shoot
• R1,440 per selected model, per shoot day
• No usage fee
• Professional swimwear shoot — no nudity

REQUIREMENTS
18+ • bikini/swimwear-ready physique • confident on camera • reliable • own swimwear + towel

TO APPLY:
DM or WhatsApp 076 180 2729 with:

1. Name and age
2. Measurements 
3. Cape Town location
4. 3–4 recent photos (clear, natural, full-body + close-up)
5. Instagram/TikTok link (not handle)
6. Modelling experience, if any

Selected talent will receive shoot dates directly based on project requirements.

A.L.T. | Astra Logistics & Talent
People. Opportunities. Beyond.

We’re currently seeking multi-talented actors, dancers, singers, voice talent, stunt performers, athletes, hosts, models, creators, and entertainers who are ready to work and take their careers to the next level.
🎬 International Idols Agency is expanding our roster!

IIA is a faith-based, boutique talent agency with a global network across Los Angeles, Texas, Florida, South Africa, Colombia, and Mexico City. We pride ourselves on being selective, personal, and family-oriented while pursuing major commercial, print, voiceover, and entertainment opportunities for our talent.

What we’re looking for:

✨ Strong on-camera presence
✨ Multiple skills are a PLUS
✨ Professional self-tape setup with proper lighting, backdrop & clear audio
✨ Ability to turn around video auditions professionally and on deadline
✨ Talent who do not currently have exclusive commercial representation

✨ WHAT AN INCREDIBLE #GALIFF2026! ✨

As I reflect on the Georgia Latino International Film Festival 2026, our hearts are full. The beauty, the energy, the extraordinary talent in every room, and the incredible moments we shared across all of our events were simply UNBELIEVABLE.

To everyone who traveled from near and far to celebrate with us—thank you. 

To our sponsors, ambassadors, filmmakers, artists, volunteers, partners, supporters, and everyone who walked through our doors: you made GALIFF 2026 unforgettable. THANK YOU

And a very special thank you to Yvette Moise. Your love for life, your love for filmmakers, and your passion for this festival are at the heart of everything we do. Without you, there is no GALIFF. ❤️

Congratulations on an amazing event and an unforgettable celebration of culture, cinema, community, and each other.
We leave #GALIFF2026 with full hearts, incredible memories, and even bigger dreams.

And now… we begin again.

🎬 GALIFF 2027
📅 Sept.30 – October 3, 2027 The Fox Theatre 
WE CAN’T WAIT TO SEE YOU AGAIN!
#GALIFF2026 #SomosGALFA #FilmFestival #OurVoicesOurStoriesOurTime #GALIFF2027 @highlight Georgia Latino International Film Festival Georgia Latino Film Alliance @follower

🎭 CASTING CALL — ELARA | A PLACE NOT MINE – THE MUSICAL

We’re looking for an actress to join the cast of **A Place Not Mine – The Musical**, performing at the **Drayton Arms Theatre, London on 29 & 30 November 2026**.

**ELARA**
Playing age: **18–25**
Female role

Elara has a darker, alternative energy — think **Jade West from Victorious** as a character reference. We’d love to find someone who is excited to explore a slightly gothic look and personality: dark aura, attitude, confidence, and potentially colourful hair/highlights.

This is an **acting-focused role**, so we’re looking for someone who enjoys building a strong character and isn’t afraid to experiment.

🎤 **Singing:** Required, but Elara does not have a solo song, so there is no specific vocal type/range required.
💃 **Dance:** Basic/intermediate level is absolutely fine. Strong dance experience is not essential.
🎭 **Experience:** You do **not** need extensive professional or stage experience. Enthusiasm, commitment and willingness to learn are much more important — we’re a supportive team and can always help each other along the way.

**Performances:**
29 & 30 November 2026
📍 Drayton Arms Theatre, London

The production is currently **unpaid**, although we are awaiting a decision regarding potential funding.

As we’re getting closer to the performances, we’re hoping to cast Elara **as soon as possible**. Ideally, the selected actress would also be available to join us for rehearsal **this Sunday**, if possible.
HOW TO APPLY

Please send us a message on Instagram at **@a.place.not.mine** introducing yourself, along with a **short 30–60 second video of you singing**.

No complicated audition or self-tape needed!

If we think you could be a good fit for Elara, we’ll contact you for a quick informal call so we can meet each other, tell you more about the production and discuss the role.

✨ **If you love acting, musical theatre, magic and the idea of bringing a slightly gothic character to life, we’d love to hear from you.**

**A PLACE NOT MINE – THE MUSICAL**
29–30 November 2026 | London

items.summary:
🎭 CASTING CALL — ELARA | A PLACE NOT MINE – THE MUSICAL

We’re looking for an actress to join the cast of **A Place Not Mine – The Musical**, performing at the **Drayton Arms Theatre, London on 29 & 30 November 2026**.

**ELARA**
Playing age: **18–25**
Female role

Elara has a darker, alternative energy — think **Jade West from Victorious** as a character reference. We’d love to find someone who is excited to explore a slightly gothic look and personality: dark aura, attitude, confidence, and potentially colourful hair/highlights.

This is an **acting-focused role**, so we’re looking for someone who enjoys building a strong character and isn’t afraid to experiment.

🎤 **Singing:** Required, but Elara does not have a solo song, so there is no specific vocal type/range required.
💃 **Dance:** Basic/intermediate level is absolutely fine. Strong dance experience is not essential.
🎭 **Experience:** You do **not** need extensive professional or stage experience. Enthusiasm, commitment and willingness to learn are much more important — we’re a supportive team and can always help each other along the way.

**Performances:**
29 & 30 November 2026
📍 Drayton Arms Theatre, London

The production is currently **unpaid**, although we are awaiting a decision regarding potential funding.

As we’re getting closer to the performances, we’re hoping to cast Elara **as soon as possible**. Ideally, the selected actress would also be available to join us for rehearsal **this Sunday**, if possible.
HOW TO APPLY

Please send us a message on Instagram at **@a.place.not.mine** introducing yourself, along with a **short 30–60 second video of you singing**.

No complicated audition or self-tape needed!

If we think you could be a good fit for Elara, we’ll contact you for a quick informal call so we can meet each other, tell you more about the production and discuss the role.

✨ **If you love acting, musical theatre, magic and the idea of bringing a slightly gothic character to life, we’d love to hear from you.**

**A PLACE NOT MINE – THE MUSICAL**
29–30 November 2026 | London
Instagram: **@a.place.not.mine**

🎬 **POMOC NA PLANIE ZDJĘCIOWYM – GDAŃSK**

Szukamy **min. 2 osób do pomocy przy nocnym planie zdjęciowym** w Gdańsku (Morski Park Handlowy).

**Termin:** NOC niedziela 11.10 / poniedziałek 12.10
**Godziny:** mniej więcej **18:00-6:00**

Szukamy:
**- 1 osoby do pomocy gafferowi** – proste zadania techniczne zgodnie z bieżącymi potrzebami na planie, najlepiej chłopak
**- 1 osoby do pomocy scenografowi** – pomoc przy przygotowaniu i ogarnianiu scenografii oraz bieżące zadania na planie

Nie wymagamy dużego doświadczenia, najważniejsze są chęci, odpowiedzialność i dyspozycyjność przez całą noc. Mile widziane osoby, które miały już styczność z planami zdjęciowymi.

**Wynagrodzenie: 400 zł netto**

Jeśli jesteś zainteresowany/a, napisz **wiadomość prywatną**

**STOP IMAGINING SOUND. START BUILDING YOUR INSTRUMENT.**

*Online Vocal Coaching Based Purely on Vocal Physiology & Physics*

Welcome to the **Vocal Gym**.

Mirella Freni's student

Guildhall School of Music and Drama graduate

Lunenburg Academy of Music Performance Artist in Residence

Most traditional coaching relies on vague visualizations and acoustic myths (*"sing in the mask"*, *"feel the sound between your eyes"*). Your voice is not a metaphor - it is a biological, physical instrument governed by muscle isolation, air pressure, and pharyngeal geometry.

Whether you are an amateur building your voice from scratch or a working professional struggling with vocal fatigue, real progress comes from concrete biomechanics:

* **Targeted Muscle Isolation:** Isolate and balance the TA (*Thyroarytenoid*) and CT (*Cricothyroid*) muscles to build genuine core power, register balance, and flexibility without strain.
* **Pharyngeal Geometry & Real Projection:** Utilize the pharyngeal resonator and *Squillo* for projection that cuts through any mix - without forcing air or spreading into a smile.
* **Zero Interference:** Eliminate throat constriction, hyoid tension, and tongue root interference at the physical source.
**WHO IS THIS FOR?**
* **Amateurs:** Build a rock-solid, healthy physiological foundation right from day one with zero fluff.
* **Professionals:** Fix stamina issues, expand your dynamic range, unlock effortless *Appoggio*, and gain 100% predictable control over your instrument.

🎁 **FREE 1st ONLINE CONSULTATION**

*30-Minute Biomechanical Vocal Audit & Diagnostic Session*

We’ll analyze your current vocal setup, pinpoint physical blockages, and lay out a clear, objective training roadmap.

📍 **Format:** 1-on-1 Online

📩 **How to book:** Send a DM now to claim your free diagnostic session. Space is limited!

**Tworzymy czułą przestrzeń twórczą, dla Twojego dziecka, na Mokotowie!**

**Mała Akademia Teatralna **Czuła Fundacja** **Centrum Twórcze Przestrzenie wystartowała!

Są jeszcze ostatnie miejsca w obydwu grupach!

Podaruj swojemu dziecku bezpieczną przestrzeń do rozwoju, profesjonalnej edukacji teatralnej i eksploracji wyobraźni!

Spotykamy się we wtorki.

Z dziećmi od 7 do 9 lat - od 16.00 do 17.30.

Z dziećmi od 9 do 12 lat od 17.30 do 19.00.

w FORMA Ośrodek Kultury

Zajęcia Małej Akademii Teatralnej to profesjonalna edukacja teatralna, w poszanowaniu granic uczestników. Na moich zajęciach dzieci się wygłupiają i szaleją. Mogą zrealizować wszystkie swoje pomysły. Twarzą pełne wsparcia relacje rówieśnicze.

Pamiętam, czego mi brakowało, kiedy jako dziecko uczyłam się teatru. I właśnie to - daję teraz dzieciom.

Jeśli chcesz dowiedzieć się więcej o naszych warsztatach artystycznych i twórczej działalności, odwiedź naszą stronę internetową: https://www.czulafundacja.pl/tworcze-przestrzenie

albo stronę FB Centrum Twórcze Przestrzenie.

Możesz też do nas napisać na adres: czulafundacja@czulafundacja.pl

Albo przyjdź ze swoim dzieckiem, w najbliższy wtorek, na zajęcia. Dołącz do naszej czułej, twórczej społeczności!

items.text:
**Budujemy czułą, twórczą społeczność na Mokotowie!**

Czuła Fundacja Centrum Twórcze Przestrzenie

Akademia Sceny wystartowała! Mamy jeszcze miejsca w grupie! Może czakamy właśnie na Ciebie?

Poznaj nas! Jesteśmy duetem twórczym. Działamy od wielu lat. Z zawodu Jesteśmy aktorami. Postanowiliśmy zbudować własną przestrzeń. W poszanowaniu dla granic. Bez przemocy i presji. Tworzymy własny teatr - profesjonalne spektakle. Prowadzimy też warsztaty artystyczne. Zapraszamy Cię do naszej Akademii Sceny. Spotykamy się w gronie dorosłych i młodzieży. Uczymy profesjonalnego teatru. Tworzymy spektakle. Wymieniamy doświadczenia. Odpoczywamy. Działamy w poczuciu bezpieczeństwa i z dbałością o dobrostan emocjonalny. Dołącz do drużyny Czułego Teatru!

Spotykamy się w środy o 17.30 w FORMA Ośrodek Kultury. 

Jeśli chcesz dowiedzieć się o nas więcej, odwiedź stronę internetową:

https://www.czulafundacja.pl/akademia-sceny

Możesz też do nas napisać na: czulafundacja@czulafundacja.pl

Albo przyjść na zajęcia w najbliższą środę!

ZAPRASZAMY!

items.text:
🎬 CASTING DO SPOTU REKLAMOWEGO

Role bez tekstu.

Zgłoszenia tylko drogą mailową

Poszukujemy aktorów/epizodystów:

Mężczyzna — 20-25 lat

Młody, atrakcyjny mężczyzna. Szczupła, proporcjonalna sylwetka.
Typ: miejski, nowoczesny, premium / corporate.
Zadbany, pewny siebie, ambitny.

Kobieta — 18-20 lat

Młoda kobieta o charakterystycznej, naturalnej urodzie i wyrazistej twarzy. Długie ciemne włosy, szczupła sylwetka.
Typ: niezależna, współczesna, z charakterem.
Mile widziana naturalna, nieoczywista uroda i mocna osobowość.

Mężczyzna — 75-85 lat

Senior o bardzo charakterystycznej twarzy, siwych włosach i zaroście. Szczupła lub średnia sylwetka.
Szukamy osoby ciepłej, wiarygodnej i emocjonalnej, potrafiącej opowiadać historię przede wszystkim spojrzeniem i mimiką.
Naturalność i autentyczność mile widziane.

Mężczyzna — 30–40 lat

Przystojny, charakterystyczny mężczyzna o wyrazistych rysach i ciemnych włosach.
Postać pojawia się w kilku okresach: lata 60,70 i 80, dlatego ważna jest możliwość wiarygodnego pokazania upływu czasu.
Typ: charyzmatyczny, męski, ekranowy.

Kobieta — 30–40 lat

Kobieta o ciepłej, klasycznej urodzie.
Kobieca, elegancka, naturalna.
Postać również pokazujemy w różnych okresach – lata 60., 70. i 80.
Ważna umiejętność wiarygodnego przechodzenia między różnymi etapami życia i stylami epoki.

Kobieta — 40–55 lat

Ciepła, zadbana, atrakcyjna kobieta o naturalnym wyglądzie.
Typ: współczesna mama – silna, troskliwa, rodzinna.
Naturalna mimika i wiarygodność przed kamerą ważniejsze niż „modelowy” wygląd.

Mężczyzna — 45–55 lat

Zadbany, męski, naturalny mężczyzna. Krótkie ciemne włosy, możliwy lekki zarost.
Typ: spokojny, pracowity, rodzinny tata.
Szukamy naturalności, ciepła i wiarygodności, bez przesadnie „reklamowego” wizerunku.

📍 Zdjęcia w Warszawie w 2 połowie października 

📩 Zgłoszenia:
blackwolfproductionpl@gmail.com

📝 W treści zgłoszenia podaj:
• Imię i nazwisko
• Wiek
• Numer telefonu
• Zdjęcie twarzy i całej sylwetki
• Demo/real (link do YouTube)

Pozostałe szczegóły przekażemy wybranym osobom.

PNW EXTRAS CASTING CALL
Production: The Flower Knight 
SAG Micro budget short film, unpaid, credited

Length: 1-2 days, October 17-18 (or just October 18)
Times: 9am call time, 7:00pm finish, with option to leave around ~1pm
Location: Port Orchard - Manchester State Park

We are looking for extras to participate in a fantasy-adventure-comedy short film. 

Logline: Years after abandoning his role as a legendary hero, a reluctant deliveryman is dragged back into his fantasy kingdom’s endless cycle of good versus evil, only to realize the true villain might not be his former nemesis, but the realm’s rigid and stifling expectations.

Food provided, car pools organized as needed. Extras will need to dress according to the guidelines listed below - if you don't have clothing that works, we might be able to provide some. 

Clothing guidelines:
Pants: corduroys, chinos, khakis, skirts (no jeans)
Shirt: floral button up or white/offwhite button up
Shoes: Dress shoes, loafers, boots (no sneakers)

NOTE: This is a fantasy film - if you have any fun fantasy-type costume pieces (like armor, swords, LARP-ing/roleplaying costumes), please feel free to bring those!

If you are available one or both days and interested in being an extra, please fill out the survey linked below and our 2nd AD will reach out with more information. 🙂

Hi! I’m Giovanna, a Brazilian filmmaker and Film Production student at York University, where I study on a full ride scholarship. I’m an award-winning director, writer, and producer, and the first Brazilian filmmaker to receive an award at the international ConnectHER Film Festival.

I’m currently casting for my upcoming short film, *A Happy Kind of Blue*, and I’d love to see your submission!

To apply, please send your **headshot and demo reel** via email, and include the **character you’re interested in playing in the subject line**.

If you’d like to learn more about me and my work, you can also find me on Instagram at **@giovanna_qb**.

Looking forward to seeing your submissions and hopefully working together!

**STOP IMAGINING SOUND. START BUILDING YOUR INSTRUMENT.**

*Online Vocal Coaching Based Purely on Vocal Physiology & Physics*

Welcome to the **Vocal Gym**.

Mirella Freni's student

Guildhall School of Music and Drama graduate

Lunenburg Academy of Music Performance Artist in Residence

Most traditional coaching relies on vague visualizations and acoustic myths (*"sing in the mask"*, *"feel the sound between your eyes"*). Your voice is not a metaphor - it is a biological, physical instrument governed by muscle isolation, air pressure, and pharyngeal geometry.

Whether you are an amateur building your voice from scratch or a working professional struggling with vocal fatigue, real progress comes from concrete biomechanics:

* **Targeted Muscle Isolation:** Isolate and balance the TA (*Thyroarytenoid*) and CT (*Cricothyroid*) muscles to build genuine core power, register balance, and flexibility without strain.
* **Pharyngeal Geometry & Real Projection:** Utilize the pharyngeal resonator and *Squillo* for projection that cuts through any mix - without forcing air or spreading into a smile.
* **Zero Interference:** Eliminate throat constriction, hyoid tension, and tongue root interference at the physical source.
**WHO IS THIS FOR?**
* **Amateurs:** Build a rock-solid, healthy physiological foundation right from day one with zero fluff.
* **Professionals:** Fix stamina issues, expand your dynamic range, unlock effortless *Appoggio*, and gain 100% predictable control over your instrument.

🎁 **FREE 1st ONLINE CONSULTATION**

*30-Minute Biomechanical Vocal Audit & Diagnostic Session*

We’ll analyze your current vocal setup, pinpoint physical blockages, and lay out a clear, objective training roadmap.

📍 **Format:** 1-on-1 Online

📩 **How to book:** Send a DM now to claim your free diagnostic session. Space is limited!

CASTING CALL FOR A MANCHESTER BASED SHORT FILM!!!

Title: Children of the Revolution 

Logline: "Children of the Revolution" is a short film about a group of young rebels who run an underground pirate radio station to oppose a fascist regime. The production will shoot a proof of concept short in Manchester in November and the main short film in spring 2027. 

Casting actors for lead roles in the Revolution Radio team!

Rehearses TBD; shoots three-day proof of concept between Nov. 9 and Nov. 22 in Manchester. Main film shoots in spring 2027 (dates and locations TBD).

We're looking for talent based in Greater Manchester, all acting roles will be unpaid however food and transport costs will be covered by the production.

Roles:

Clash - Mid to late 20s, any ethnicity, male. Clash is the leader of Revolution radio! He dresses like a punk but has a laid back demeanour although he must always remain observant since he's in constant danger.

Roxy - Early 20s to mid 20s, any ethnicity, female. Roxy's the main radio presenter. She's cool, glamorous and knows her 70s stuff while remaining level headed under pressure.

Ziggy - early to mid 20s, any ethnicity, any gender. Ziggy's the tech support of the radio station, they're a nervous nerd that panics at the first sign on trouble so they like to play things safe.

Rex: Early to mid 20s, Rex is the loose cannon of the group. His main role is to drive the rebellious actions of the group and push for change.

If you're interested, please email me at s.a.conlon@edu.salford.ac.uk 

Thank you for considering our film!!!

items.text:
Hi! We are seeking actors for our student film, "FIREWALL", shooting in Denver

Logline: During a museum tour, a wealthy woman becomes fixated on a million dollar painting that is hung facing the wall. When her attempts to buy it are denied, her obsession with unveiling the mysterious painting grows.

Synopsis: The moment Anais Poklova lays eyes on the canvas, she will stop at nothing to have it. Titled *The Most Beautiful Painting, *and yet, since the artist’s death, nobody alive has seen what’s on the other side of it. Anais makes an offer, but the tour guide, Joseph, informs her that the painting is protected and cannot be bought. Anais can’t accept this. Like fire lighting up dry kindling, her mind becomes consumed by thoughts of the painting, bringing out the worst of her insatiable, deep-seeded need for control. She comes up with a plan, returns to the museum, and boldly offers Joseph a bribe; if he helps her steal the painting, she’ll give him the money he needs to save his family. It goes against everything he believes in, but Joseph and Anais both know that when it comes to family, there isn’t really a choice. Joseph agrees to the heist, and Anais is so close to victory she can taste it. With nothing standing between her and painting, Joseph suddenly realizes that there may be a way to stop Anais *and *keep the money.

This will be an unpaid, reel opportunity tentatively shooting Nov 6-8th with an extra day the weekend of Nov 13th.

Food will be provided and transportation if needed. 

**In-Person auditions will be held on Oct 4th from 2-5 PM at the Central Denver Library in room #242**

**Audition slots can be selected via the link below!**

**Audition reels can be submitted to parranika20@gmail.com!**

[https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfUc6Sqynn5xzrffrVVK8AKNNOpISb1mfBOS4pIUSrARJHOgA/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=111879408904497575567](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfUc6Sqynn5xzrffrVVK8AKNNOpISb1mfBOS4pIUSrARJHOgA/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=111879408904497575567)

– krótkiego self-tape’u,
– aktualnego zdjęcia,
– wieku i wzrostu,
– numeru kontaktowego do rodzica/opiekuna.

📩 Zgłoszenia: [krzysztof.rowicki@amafilmacademy.pl](mailto:krzysztof.rowicki@amafilmacademy.pl)

items.text:
Hi everyone!!

My name is Mackenzie, I am 23 from Santa Clarita, CA and for the last 6 years I have been saying I want to break into the film industry.

It started with the Saw franchise, I was so enthralled with the practical effects I just knew I had to do something like that myself!

I know Los Angeles is over saturated and its a fight for even experienced workers to find jobs right now,
But I am extremely determined to get my foot in the film industry door and would accept ANY help or advice. 

I love making things with my hands
I love people 
I am extremely willing to learn and help
I follow directions and love asking questions 
And I am currently in the middle of a career change.

My goal is to one day Make props or help with set design but I understand that comes with time and knowing the right people.

Does anyone have any advice they would be willing to spare? 

Thank you so much in advance!

topComments.text: Networking. The internet is your friend. Google prop masters, prop houses, the fabrication companies,th look up these people that did your favorite movies, that you want to emulate. Know their body of work. use Imdb. Follow them on their socials. If they have a website email them. Ask if they take interns. Follow your local production groups on facebook. Build your resume. Start building small props and take progress photos for portfolio. You'll never know if you don't try. Information is power. Knowing the players in the game.
Check out my comment in the other group you posted this 😀

LIVE PRESENTERS WANTED – START ASAP 🎥

Swiss Peak is a health & wellness brand based in Huyton, Liverpool, and we’re looking for two confident, energetic Live Presenters to join our team.

You’ll be hosting our live shopping sessions, showcasing our products, chatting with viewers and creating an exciting, engaging atmosphere that keeps people watching and buying.

THE ROLE
We currently have two presenter slots available:
Morning Presenter – 4 hours per day
Afternoon Presenter – 4 hours per day
Monday–Friday | Based in Huyton, Liverpool
We’re ideally looking for presenters who can commit to a regular weekday slot and become a familiar face of Swiss Peak.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR
We want someone who is:

Bubbly, confident and naturally engaging
Comfortable speaking and selling on camera
Genuinely interested in health, wellness and supplements
Able to maintain energy and enthusiasm throughout a 4-hour live
Good at pacing themselves and keeping conversation flowing
Able to get viewers excited about products, offers and promotions
Reliable and comfortable working to a regular schedule

Energy is particularly important during major sales periods such as Black Friday and the lead-up to Christmas, when our live sessions can get especially busy.

Previous live presenting, sales, TikTok Shop, retail, hosting or content creation experience would be a big advantage, but personality and confidence are just as important to us.

PAY
£15–£20 per hour, depending on previous experience.

START DATE
ASAP
If you’re confident on camera, love speaking to people and think you could bring great energy to Swiss Peak Lives, we’d love to hear from you.
Apply with a little information about yourself, your availability and any relevant presenting, sales or content experience.

LIVE PRESENTERS WANTED – START ASAP 🎥

Swiss Peak is a health & wellness brand based in Huyton, Liverpool, and we’re looking for two confident, energetic Live Presenters to join our team.

You’ll be hosting our live shopping sessions, showcasing our products, chatting with viewers and creating an exciting, engaging atmosphere that keeps people watching and buying.

THE ROLE
We currently have two presenter slots available:
Morning Presenter – 4 hours per day
Afternoon Presenter – 4 hours per day
Monday–Friday | Based in Huyton, Liverpool
We’re ideally looking for presenters who can commit to a regular weekday slot and become a familiar face of Swiss Peak.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR
We want someone who is:

Bubbly, confident and naturally engaging
Comfortable speaking and selling on camera
Genuinely interested in health, wellness and supplements
Able to maintain energy and enthusiasm throughout a 4-hour live
Good at pacing themselves and keeping conversation flowing
Able to get viewers excited about products, offers and promotions
Reliable and comfortable working to a regular schedule

Energy is particularly important during major sales periods such as Black Friday and the lead-up to Christmas, when our live sessions can get especially busy.

Previous live presenting, sales, TikTok Shop, retail, hosting or content creation experience would be a big advantage, but personality and confidence are just as important to us.

PAY
£15–£20 per hour, depending on previous experience.

START DATE
ASAP
If you’re confident on camera, love speaking to people and think you could bring great energy to Swiss Peak Lives, we’d love to hear from you.
Apply with a little information about yourself, your availability and any relevant presenting, sales or content experience.

🎭 CASTING CALL — ELARA | A PLACE NOT MINE – THE MUSICAL

We’re looking for an actress to join the cast of **A Place Not Mine – The Musical**, performing at the **Drayton Arms Theatre, London on 29 & 30 November 2026**.

**ELARA**
Playing age: **18–25**
Female role

Elara has a darker, alternative energy — think **Jade West from Victorious** as a character reference. We’d love to find someone who is excited to explore a slightly gothic look and personality: dark aura, attitude, confidence, and potentially colourful hair/highlights.

This is an **acting-focused role**, so we’re looking for someone who enjoys building a strong character and isn’t afraid to experiment.

🎤 **Singing:** Required, but Elara does not have a solo song, so there is no specific vocal type/range required.
💃 **Dance:** Basic/intermediate level is absolutely fine. Strong dance experience is not essential.
🎭 **Experience:** You do **not** need extensive professional or stage experience. Enthusiasm, commitment and willingness to learn are much more important — we’re a supportive team and can always help each other along the way.

**Performances:**
29 & 30 November 2026
📍 Drayton Arms Theatre, London

The production is currently **unpaid**, although we are awaiting a decision regarding potential funding.

As we’re getting closer to the performances, we’re hoping to cast Elara **as soon as possible**. Ideally, the selected actress would also be available to join us for rehearsal **this Sunday**, if possible.
HOW TO APPLY

Please send us a message on Instagram at **@a.place.not.mine** introducing yourself, along with a **short 30–60 second video of you singing**.

No complicated audition or self-tape needed!

If we think you could be a good fit for Elara, we’ll contact you for a quick informal call so we can meet each other, tell you more about the production and discuss the role.

✨ **If you love acting, musical theatre, magic and the idea of bringing a slightly gothic character to life, we’d love to hear from you.**

**A PLACE NOT MINE – THE MUSICAL**
29–30 November 2026 | London
Instagram: **@a.place.not.mine**

**Casting Call - Manchester!** 

**Front Of House and Merchandise Team - Haribo Holly Jolly Christmas Grotto**

Could you help make magical moments at our grotto this Christmas?

We are looking for friendly, energetic and tech-savvy front of house and merch team members to join us at the Haribo Holly Jolly Grotto at the Trafford Centre!

**The role includes:**
* Welcoming and checking in families - using the QR ticket system
* Helping guests begin their grotto experience, managing queues, answering queries
* Keeping the set, entrance and shop clean and tidy, vacuuming etc
* Restocking and moving stock, moving heavy boxes & curating the “shop"
* Using our till points, contactless card readers & changing receipt paper. 
* Serving customers, packing gifts, and goods bought. 
* Supporting the Lead Merch and Event Manager

**Location: **Trafford Centre, Manchester.

**Pay:** £15 per hour

Bonus: An additional £10 daily bonus if you complete all dates you commit to

Travel expenses are not covered

**Grotto dates:**

Training day - 18th of November

November: 19th-22nd, 26th-29th

December: 3rd-6th , 10th-13th , 17th-24th 

Weekend availability is essential.

Shift patterns vary, with short morning or afternoon shifts and full-day shifts of up to 13 hours.

**DBS:** Our clients require all workers to hold a basic DBS issued within the last 3 years. 

Ready to bring some Holly Jolly magic to Manchester this Christmas?

Please send us an email to performance@bakehousefactory.co.uk expressing your interest, and include: 

your availability for the run and for an online interview on Monday 12th Oct, along with your CV 

Bakehouse Factory is committed to inclusive casting and we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

Hi everyone!! 🎬 CASTING CALL OPEN!! 🎬

For our Film & Tv Production Course, we are a making a Neo Noir Crime Thriller short film and we are looking for actors!! 

Project Title: Blood on Blue Notes
Project Type: Student Short Film (Under 15mins)
Filming Location: Birmingham, England (+15 mile radius) (Exact locations TBD)
Shooting Dates: November (Exact dates TBD)
Casting Deadline: October 18th (may be extended if roles aren’t filled)
Compensation: Unpaid (unfortunately), but the finished project will be given to you for Showreel/Portfolio material.

Story Summary
A jazz singer turned vigilante, delivering justice one bloodied note at a time.

Character Descriptions

Miss Josephine Rainey
Role: Lead
Age Range: 20-29
Appearance: Black Actor, Entrancing Eyes, glamorous old Hollywood look, star quality
Language: English
Mature Themes: Will be killing on-screen and have on-screen suggestive intimate actions
Other: Singing is required. Strong jazz/blues vocal skills preferred.

Little Miss Birdie
Role: Supporting
Age Range: 20-29
Appearance: Any Race, ‘Betty Boop’ look, petite, younger appearance, contagious smile
Language: English
Mature Themes: On-screen suggestive actions, such as tease/ innuendos
Other: Dancing is preferred (tap, Charleston, foxtrot, jive etc). Possibly Singing required. 

Mama Selma
Role: Supporting
Age Range: 30-50
Appearance: Black Actor, Mature, Full Figure, Glamorous Soulful Look
Language: English 
Mature Themes: There may be on-screen action shots of protective fight/actions, Smoking on-screen (can be made fake if not a smoker) 
Other: N/A

Bit Parts & Extras:
Comedic/Flirty Bartender - Male, 25-35, Any Race (preferably Black)
Criminals - Male, 20-30, White
Doorman - Male, 20-30, White
Jazz Band - Authentic jazz players preferred, All Ages, All Races
Bar Patrons - All Ages, All Races

*all actors including bit parts and extras must wear 1920s costume!!

If you are interested and think you fit the role requirements please send an email to ebony.tearbanner@gmail.com with the following:
• Name
• Age
• Location
• Which role(s) you are interested in
• OPTIONAL Headshots
• OPTIONAL Showreel
• OPTIONAL Acting Resume

You will then be sent your audition scripts for the self tapes, please send your completed self tape back to ebony.tearbanner@gmail.com with any other necessary content.

If you have any issues with email let me know and we can arrange an alternative method.

We can’t wait to see your interpretations!! 🖤

items.text:
CASTING CALL | STUDENT PRODUCTION
Hi, we are casting for roles in our upcoming project shot on 16mm.  BASED IN LONDON

Here are the descriptions of the characters.

Character name : Jean  

role size : lead

Playing age range : 25-35

Gender : Male

Personality : Jean is an aloof character who believes others can clean up his mess. He is clumsy and careless. He is driven by his need to do what he wants

He is paired on a stakeout with Ella who is his complete opposite. When tasked to work together he learns in the importance of helping others aswell as realising his feelings for her.

character name : Ella

role size : lead

playing age range : 25-35 

gender : female

personality : Ella is an extremely work driven character. She believes she must strive for perfection. She is organized and well kept. She is driven by her need to do everything her way. 

She is paired on a stakeout with Jean who is unreliable and lazy. When tasked to work together she learns that she doesn’t always need to be perfect whilst realising Jean is not as annoying as he seems.

Since it is a student film, we don’t have much of a budget to pay our actors. So this will be a voluntary role. However we will pay for your travel costs and food and drink on set. 

Being so, it is ideal if you’re based in or around London.

To get in touch please email: 45.castingcall@gmail.com 

With your headshots preferably.

🚨 $40-$50/HR NEXT WEEK!!!
Branded Promo Talent, a leading experiential marketing agency, is seeking dependable, outgoing, and professional Event Managers and Brand Ambassadors for brand launch activations across five markets next week!

Dates, Times & Locations:
📍 Memphis, TN
Mon, Oct 5 → Tues, Oct 6, 2026
11:00 PM–7:00 AM

📍 Raleigh, NC
Mon, Oct 5 → Tues, Oct 6, 2026
10:00 PM–6:00 AM

📍 Cleveland, OH
Thurs, Oct 8, 2026
1:00 AM–7:00 AM

📍 Jacksonville, FL
Weds, Oct 7 → Thurs, Oct 8, 2026
10:00 PM–7:00 AM

📍 Kansas City, MO
Thurs, Oct 8, 2026
8:00 AM–4:00 PM

All times are onsite hours and include setup, activation, and breakdown for both roles.

Compensation:
• Event Managers: $50 per hour
• Brand Ambassadors: $40 per hour

— 1099, paid weekly —

Event Managers will receive additional paid hours for offsite pickups and returns.

Event Details:
Help introduce new products from a national food brand to employees, warehouse teams, and drivers before they reach the market. The activation will feature product sampling, food, refreshments, giveaways, and an onsite raffle.

Event Manager Duties:
• Coordinate logistics, lead the onsite team, and manage event flow.
• Pick up and return event supplies at Southwest Cargo near the airport.
• Collect Walmart orders containing food, refreshments, and event supplies.
• Transport equipment and lead team setup, breakdown, and loading.
• Oversee sampling, food and refreshments, giveaways, and raffle participation.
• Complete a recap report through Google Forms and upload event photos to Google Drive.

Event Manager Requirements:
• Must have a truck, SUV, or van capable of transporting a 10×10 tent, table, backdrop, banner, premiums, and supplies.
• Must be available for pickups and returns before and after the event.
• Must have prior Event Manager experience and strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
• Must lead by example, actively performing Brand Ambassador duties while guiding and supporting the team.

Brand Ambassador Duties:
• Assist with unloading, setup, breakdown, packing, and loading.
• Welcome employees and drivers and introduce products using approved messaging.
• Assist with product sampling, food, refreshments, and giveaways.
• Encourage raffle participation and explain entry instructions.
• Keep the activation clean and organized while supporting smooth guest flow.
• Support the Event Manager and represent the brand professionally.

Staff Expectations:
We are looking for punctual, dependable, and engaging staff who work well as a team. You must be comfortable assisting with setup and breakdown and working the full scheduled shift, including overnight hours where applicable.

Application Process:
To be considered, email chrissy@brandedpromotalent.com with the following:
• Market & Role
• Availability
• Resume
• Headshot
• Relevant experience
• A brief description of why you’re an excellent fit for this role
• Event Managers - confirm you have a truck, SUV, or van to transport assets.

Please use “Brand Launch — [City/Role]” as the subject of your email.

Note: Only applicants who follow all instructions will be considered. Our team will review qualifications via email and schedule a call with eligible candidates.

Er du ægte Annika fan? Så er det måske lige noget for dig 👀

Vi er i gang med at caste til et nyt sjovt koncept, hvor 6 ægte Annika fans skal dyste mod 1 bedrager, som skal forsøge at bluffe sig til at være fan af Annika.

Gennem forskellige runder skal I snakke om Annika, hendes musik, sange, koncerter og jeres oplevelser som fans, mens I samtidig skal prøve at gennemskue, hvem der ikke er den ægte fan.

Det foregår i København NV, og der er 1.000 kr. på spil. Hvis bedrageren bliver afsløret, deler de ægte fans præmien. Hvis bedrageren slipper igennem, vinder personen hele beløbet.

Kender du en ægte Annika fan, som kunne være med? Så tag gerne personen her eller send opslaget videre.

Læs mere og tilmeld dig her:
[https://contentcasting.dk/castings/75689658-2031-4efe-bef3-913dcc9a1dde](https://contentcasting.dk/castings/75689658-2031-4efe-bef3-913dcc9a1dde)

**Håndmodel søges til lønnede Arla-optagelser den 7. og 8. oktober**

På vegne af Arla, The Barn, søger jeg en håndmodel til vores kommende optagelser. Vi søger en person med hænder og kropsbygning, der ligner personen på de vedhæftede referencebilleder - gerne med en let solbrun hudtone og uden synlige tatoveringer på hænder, arme og overkrop.

Optagelserne foregår i Viby J, Aarhus, og det er en fordel, hvis du bor i Aarhus eller omegn. På optagelserne vil du være iført sportstøj, og kun hænder og overkrop vil være synlige, uden ansigt eller andre genkendelige kendetegn. Jobbet er lønnet, og vi ønsker en aftale med total buyout af rettighederne til materialet.

Er du interesseret og tilgængelig på de nævnte datoer, så send mig gerne en mail med billeder af dine hænder og dig selv samt en kort beskrivelse af dig.

Mail: [ext_cecch@arlafoods.com](mailto:ext_cecch@arlafoods.com)
Bemærk, at vi kun kontakter de kandidater, der matcher det, vi søger.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

FUNDET

Miso Film leder efter statister til TV2 serie.

Vi skal lave nogle ekstra optagelser og hertil skal vi bruge nogle statister. 

Optagelserne ligger:

Tirsdag d. 6/10 fra kl. ca. 08:00-18:00 I et storcenter.

Onsdag d. 7/10 fra kl. ca. 08:00-15:00 I et hus.

(Begge steder i Københavnsområdet)

Om tirsdagen, skal vi  bruge cafegæster/handlene i et storcenter og det er her at vi skal bruge flest statister.

Onsdag, skal jeg bruge 2 stk. betjente som skal i politiuniform og 1 stk. som skal være civile betjent, samt 1 nabo.

Er der nogen af jer, der har tid og lyst til at være med én af dagene? 😊

Det er lønnet - 700 kr. for en hel dag og 400 for en halv.

Hvis det har intresse, så send venligst en mail til statistpaafristelsen@gmail.com. Send dit fulde navn, telefonnummer og et vellignende billede af dig selv.

Håber at høre fra én af jer.

MVH 

William

[ENG BELOW]

🔥 „FAHRENHEIT” - OPEN CASTING

Jesteś aktorem, aktorką, performerem, performerką - a może po prostu osobą z mocną sceniczną osobowością i ciekawością, by spróbować czegoś nowego?

Zapraszamy do castingu do „Fahrenheit” - nowej międzynarodowej koprodukcji Teatru im. Jana Kochanowskiego w Opolu, realizowanej we współpracy z fix+foxy, w reżyserii duńskiego reżysera Tue Bieringa.

Szukamy osób otwartych na wspólne tworzenie, eksperymentowanie, pracę na styku różnych dziedzin i wnoszenie do procesu własnej wyobraźni i energii.

Casting odbędzie się w dwóch etapach: online (formularz + krótkie wideo w języku angielskim), a następnie wybrane osoby zostaną zaproszone na drugi etap castingu na żywo w Opolu z reżyserem.

👉 Zgłoszenia online do 16 października 2026.

Szczegóły i formularz zgłoszeniowy: https://forms.gle/7D2a7U1dN8bLkHAX6 

Przyjdź. Poznajmy się. Zobaczmy, co możemy stworzyć razem. 🔥

[ENG]

🔥 FAHRENHEIT - OPEN CASTING

Are you an actor, performer, dancer, or simply someone with a strong stage presence and a curiosity to explore something new?

We invite you to audition for “Fahrenheit” - a new international theatre coproduction by JK Opole Theatre, created in collaboration with fix&foxy and directed by Danish director Tue Biering.

We are looking for people open to collaboration, experimentation, working across disciplines and bringing their own imagination and energy into the process.

The casting has two stages: online (application form + short video in English), followed by an in-person casting in Opole with the director.

👉 Applications are open until 16 October 2026.

Find full details and the application form here: https://forms.gle/7D2a7U1dN8bLkHAX6 

Come and meet us. Let’s see what we can create together. 🔥

🎬 **CASTING CALL — FEMALE LEAD PUNJABI SPEAKING**
Volunteer Opportunity | SoulTales Creative

Seeking a South Asian actress with a playing age of 30–35 to play Avneet in our indie Punjabi short film, *Bhanji - Sabotage*.

Avneet is tired of dating but still hopeful about finding love. When someone she connects with suddenly goes quiet, her doubts resurface. The role calls for natural acting that captures vulnerability, hope and anxiety.

Prior acting or on-camera experience is strongly preferred. We’re looking for a committed performer who can dedicate time to character preparation before the shoot. This role is suited to someone who is comfortable acting and understands the preparation and rehearsal process. It is not suitable for someone exploring acting for the first time.

**Location:** Langley / Abbotsford, BC
**Shoot:** One day; Tentatively on a weekend in late October. Additional preparation time required.
**Compensation:** Volunteer / unpaid role

To apply, send your headshot, acting reel or performance clip, a brief summary of your experience, and availability to 📩 [soultales.ca@gmail.com](mailto:soultales.ca@gmail.com) Subject: Avneet for Bhanji - Sabotage Casting Or DM us [@soultales_creative](https://www.instagram.com/soultales_creative/) on Instagram

🎥 LOOKING FOR A VIDEOGRAPHER

I’m looking for a videographer to join my personal dance film project in Łódź this November.

I’m looking for someone who is open to experimentation, curious about movement, and excited to dive fully into the creative process — not just film it.

• NON-PROFIT PROJECT
All expenses on my side — studio, food, transportation, etc.

You’ll be working with an amazing creative team and have the freedom to experiment, create and add a strong artistic project to your portfolio.

If this sounds like something you’d genuinely enjoy creating with us — DM me on Instagram https://www.instagram.com/serafimakiseleva_?stkn=NXF4aXJpM2dyajN6&utm_source=qr 
Let’s talk, share ideas and see where we can take it.

Hej! 😊 Mam pytanie czy ktoś może polecić legitną, sprawdzoną agencję aktorską/castingową w województwie małopolskim, do której można zgłosić 16-latkę?

Chodzi mi o agencję, w której można normalnie przejść rekrutację/casting, zostać przyjętym i później dostawać propozycje do reklam, seriali, filmów, sesji itp. Zależy mi na prawdziwej, działającej agencji, a nie na żadnych podejrzanych „szkołach aktorskich” czy płatnych obietnicach kariery.

Jeśli ktoś ma doświadczenie z taką agencją albo sam/sama jest w jakiejś i może polecić, będę bardzo wdzięczna za nazwę i opinie! ❤️

Hong Kong’s acclaimed film of the year, 《We’re Nothing At All（我們不是什麼）》will arrive in Los Angeles in October. Director Herman Yau (邱禮濤導演), along with lead actors AK (江𤒹生) from the Hong Kong group Mirror ，and Ansonbean (陳毅燊), will hold three screening and Q&A events in Los Angeles on October 7, 9, and 10. 

Everyone is welcome to register and purchase tickets to attend.

*Please check the official website of the organizer, Blacklight Global Entertainment, for ticket details:

https://www.blacklight-global.com

Official Instagram:

https://www.instagram.com/blacklightglobal.usa?stkn=MXQ3cXZiazV2MWNuaw==

———————————

You are welcome to register and purchase tickets to participate.

 • October 7 at USC – Free registration：

https://cinema.usc.edu/events/event.cfm?id=73397

 • October 9 at UCLA – Free registration：

https://www.international.ucla.edu/ccs/event/17766

——————————

 • October 10 public screening at The Culver Theater – Tickets available for purchase：

https://web.theculvertheater.com/films/Were-Nothing-At-All/HO00000747

——————————————

Media inquiries: 

info@blacklight-global.com

🎩🕵️ Geheimagent für außergewöhnliche Geburtstagsmission gesucht! 🕵️🎩
Für den 9. Geburtstag meines Sohnes suchen wir eine kreative Person mit schauspielerischem Talent, die Lust hat, Teil eines ganz besonderen Agenten-Abenteuers zu werden.

📅 Wann:

Idealerweise am 31.10. (alternativ 01.11./ 07.11 / 08.11)

📍 Wo:

Unterschleißheim bei München

⏱ Dauer:

Ca. 2 Stunden

👦 Teilnehmer:

Etwa 6 bis 10 Kinder im Alter von 9 bis 11 Jahren.

Die Idee:

Zu Beginn der Feier klingelt ein vermeintlicher Geheimagent an der Tür. Er erscheint in passender Agentenkleidung und sollte auf die Kinder möglichst authentisch und glaubwürdig wirken. Die Kinder sollen wirklich das Gefühl haben, dass ein echter Agent ihre Hilfe benötigt.

Er erzählt, dass er einen gefährlichen Täter verfolgt und dringend Unterstützung bei den Ermittlungen braucht. Gemeinsam mit den Kindern geht er auf Spurensuche, sammelt Beweise, untersucht Hinweise und löst Rätsel.

Wir stellen uns dabei Aktivitäten wie beispielsweise Fingerabdruckanalysen, das Entschlüsseln geheimer Botschaften, versteckte Hinweise, geheime Dokumente, Codes, UV-Hinweise, Tatortspuren oder ähnliche Agenten- und Detektivaufgaben vor. Hier würden wir uns auch über eigene kreative Ideen und Erfahrungen freuen.

Der große Plot-Twist:

Im Laufe der Ermittlungen verdichten sich die Hinweise immer mehr. Am Ende führen alle Spuren zu einem Safe oder einem geheimen Versteck. Dort finden die Kinder schließlich ein Foto des Täters und erkennen überrascht, dass es sich um den Geheimagenten handelt, der sie durch die gesamte Mission begleitet hat.

In diesem Moment wird jedoch die Wahrheit aufgedeckt: Die Agentur wusste bereits von seinem Verrat und hat die Kinder bewusst in die Ermittlungen eingebunden, um seine Tarnung zu entlarven. Die Kinder haben erfolgreich den Fall gelöst und den Täter überführt.

Zum Abschluss werden sie offiziell für ihren Einsatz geehrt und als Nachwuchsagenten ausgezeichnet.

Wichtig:

Wir suchen keine klassische Kinderanimation, sondern jemanden, der die Rolle überzeugend spielen kann und Freude an Improvisation und Storytelling hat. Die Kinder sollen für etwa zwei Stunden vollständig in die Geschichte eintauchen können. Ziel ist ein Erlebnis, das sich möglichst wie ein spannender Agentenfilm anfühlt.

Wir haben bereits viele Ideen für Story, Rätsel und Ablauf und würden diese gerne gemeinsam weiterentwickeln.

Die Tätigkeit wird selbstverständlich angemessen vergütet.

Falls du Interesse hast oder jemanden empfehlen kannst, freuen wir uns über eine Nachricht mit ein paar Informationen zu dir sowie gerne Fotos, Referenzen oder kurzen Videos.

Vielen Dank!

Anna

HASTER: MANDLIG STATIST SØGES TIL AFGANGSFILM - DEN DANSKE FILMSKOLE

Til afgangsfilmen ANGELS, instrueret af Jonatan Egholm Keis og produceret af Astrid Andreasen, søger vi en mandlig statist til at spille en indsat i et fængsel.

Optagelserne foregår i Albertslund nu på fredag d. 9. oktober i tidsrummet 13.30-16.00.

Er det dig? Eller kender du nogen? Så hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Send en mail til statisten.nu@gmail.com med fulde navn, alder, kontaktoplysninger og et vellignende billede.

Skriv: *"Fængsel"* i emnefeltet.

OBS: Kun henvendelser via mail vil blive besvaret.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

***Om filmen***

*ANGELS er en rockerfilm uden læderveste, motorcykler, narko og pistoler. Det er en moderne gangsterfilm til den tid, vi lever i, som fokuserer på mennesket bag den kriminelle etikette.*

Deltagelse er ulønnet, men der vil være forplejning på set.

Lead actress dancer needed for horror short
🎬 CASTING CALL – MIA (LEAD ROLE) | SHORT PSYCHOLOGICAL HORROR FILM 

I’m looking for a talented actress and dancer to play Mia, the lead character in my upcoming independent psychological horror short film, HIM.

ABOUT THE FILM

HIM follows Mia, a young woman who begins to feel that she is being watched. When a mysterious woman repeatedly appears in her life, Mia finds herself caught in a disturbing series of events that blur the line between reality and something far more sinister.

ROLE: MIA (LEAD)

* Female, mid-20s (flexible).

* Must have some dance experience, ideally in contemporary, interpretive or expressive dance.

* Comfortable portraying fear, vulnerability, anxiety and emotional distress.

* Able to convey emotion through facial expressions, body language and movement.

* Confident performing both dramatic acting scenes and a solo dance sequence.

💃 DANCE REQUIREMENT

The film opens with a cinematic, black-and-white dance sequence featuring Mia performing a contemporary / interpretive solo. The choreography will be expressive, graceful and fluid, using controlled movements, turns and extensions to create an almost hypnotic atmosphere that gradually becomes unsettling.

You don’t need to be a professionally trained dancer, but you should feel comfortable moving expressively on camera. The choreography will be discussed and developed collaboratively.

PRODUCTION DETAILS

* Location: Bolton / York 

* Shoot dates: To be confirmed but most likely mid November 

* Genre: Psychological Horror

* Format: Independent short film

A NOTE ABOUT THE PRODUCTION

As a new independent director, I’m at the beginning of my filmmaking journey and am currently working with a very limited budget. This is an unpaid opportunity, and I sincerely appreciate your understanding and consideration. Food and refreshments will be provided during filming, alongside screen credit and footage for your acting showreel, where possible.

I’m passionate about creating a cinematic, atmospheric film and would love to collaborate with someone who shares that enthusiasm for independent filmmaking.

HOW TO APPLY

If you’re interested, please send me a direct message with:

* A recent photograph.

* A little about yourself and your acting or dance experience.

* Any showreel or dance footage you may have (if available).

I will send self tape dialogues after that. 

Please feel free to share this post with anyone who may be suitable. 

Thank you! 🎬

Hi everyone! 👋
I’m currently looking for a female actress to take part in a 6-episode TV drama project I’m producing for university.

It’s an unpaid university project, with each episode following a different character as part of one interconnected story. We’re looking for someone who would be interested in taking on a role across the series.

We’re particularly looking for someone who is available to film this Thursday for Episode 1. There may also be additional filming days required depending on the role.

If you’re interested, or know someone who might be, please feel free to message me and I can send over more information about the project, character and filming requirements.

Thanks!

Samuel 🎬

Greetings Actors! Seeking an African American male actor who has singing talent and is comfortable playing a gay role as Franklin. We also have an open role as Stanley, and details for each character are below for our upcoming stage production, which is coming on December 12th and 19th, performing live in both Macon & Atlanta, GA. These are paid roles. Please do not submit if you are not reliable or unable to attend scheduled rehearsals. These are every Tuesday and Thursday via Zoom, 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM, and in person every 1st and 3rd Saturdays from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM. Accepting castings from local Atlanta actors or surrounding cities. Auditions are held via Zoom. Please submit Headshots along with contact info.  

Franklin: Male, age range 27 to 33. Full of life, funny, always has jokes, and sings his heart out. However, he's keeping a secret boyfriend that he thinks no one in the family knows about. Must be comfortable playing a gay role and must be able to sing.

Stanley: Male, age range 25 to 30. Cool, laid-back, friendly guy unlike his sister and mother.  

For submissions: Taraentertainmentllc@gmail.com

🎭 Actors & Actresses we’d love to connect with you.

Hi everyone! I’m Lee Miller, Co-Founder & President of EverRise Talent Group, which I founded alongside our Co-Founder & CEO, Ashley Albertson Simpson.

We’re a growing talent agency connecting with actors and other creatives who are serious about developing their craft, building their careers, and finding new opportunities.

Ashley and I built EverRise around a simple belief: representation should be personal. We want to know more than what’s on your résumé or reel. We want to understand who you are, what kind of work you’re pursuing, and where you hope to take your career.

If you’re an actor looking for representation, exploring your next step, or simply interested in learning more about EverRise, feel free to introduce yourself in the comments or visit our website.

We’d love to meet some of the talented people in this community. 🎬

🌐 www.everrisetalentgroup.com
📱 Follow EverRise Talent Group on Instagram & Facebook

Ashley Simpson - Co-Founder & CEO
Lee Miller - Co-Founder & President

AKTORZY DO SPOTU REKLAMOWEGO LICEALNEGO FESTIWALU FILMOWEGO POSZUKIWANI, 24-25.10. WARSZAWA, NON-PROFIT

Poszukujemy aktorów do produkcji spotu promocyjnego Festiwalu Filmowego 9 Minut organizowanego przez IX Liceum im. Hoffmanowej. Produkcja będzie odbywać się w dniach 24-25 października. Poniżej dostępne są opisy osób jakich szukamy oraz charakterystyki ich postaci. Zainteresowanych prosimy o kontakt na maila: casting.aslawinski@gmail.com. 

1. - Tomasz Wiranda - 20 - Wysoki, pewny siebie brunet, sprytny, umie wybrnąć z każdej sytuacji. Postać kreowana na Franka Abagnale’a z "Złap mnie, jeśli potrafisz".

2. - Agent CBŚP 1 - 40 - Starszy, łysy, doświadczony, poważny, skupiony na swojej pracy, spokojnie rozwiązuje sprawę

3. - Agent CBŚP II - 30 - Młodszy niż Agent I, szybko się niecierpliwi, ma więcej humoru, wigoru niż jego wspólnik

4. - Organizatorka - 25 - Elegancka, brunetka lub blondyna, ciepła,  zdezorientowana, kiedy widzi CBŚP

5. - Mężczyzna od dalmatyńczyka - 28 - Wysoki, przystojny i elegancki, czarnoskóry mężczyzna, który stoi z psem na smyczy odznacza się swoją aparycją,

6. - Kelner - 23 - Młody chłopak, spłoszony agentami, zdziwiony na ich widok

7. - Dubler Tomasza  Wiranda - 20 - młody mężczyzna, możliwie jak najbardziej zbliżony do wyglądu i sylwetki Tomasza, nie będzie widać jego twarzy

items.text:
CASTING DO FILMU KRÓTKOMETRAŻOWEGO                        Szukam dwójki aktorów (dziewczyna + chłopak), w wieku 18-22 lata, do mojej etiudy krótkometrażowej realizowanej na dyplom.

Film opowiada o dwojgu młodych tancerzach, którzy chcą zatańczyć razem wspólną choreografię. Każde z nich ma inną wizję i podejście do tańca, a próba stworzenia czegoś razem zaczyna odsłaniać ich różnice, lęki i potrzebę bycia zrozumianym.

Najlepiej, jeśli zgłaszające się osoby są prywatnie parą – zależy mi na naturalnej relacji i chemii między bohaterami. Mile widziane jest również lekkie doświadczenie w tańcu, ale nie jest wymagane profesjonalne przygotowanie.

Zdjęcia będą realizowane w Zduńskiej Woli. Udział w projekcie jest nonprofit.

Jeśli jesteście zainteresowani, podeślijcie mi w wiadomości prywatnej kilka słów o sobie oraz aktualne zdjęcie. 

Więcej informacji o projekcie, rolach i terminach przekażę prywatnie.

Jeśli znacie kogoś, kto mógłby być zainteresowany, będę wdzięczny za udostępnienie.

Najlepiej, jeśli zgłaszające się osoby są prywatnie parą – zależy mi na naturalnej relacji i chemii między bohaterami. Mile widziane jest również lekkie doświadczenie w tańcu, ale nie jest wymagane profesjonalne przygotowanie.

Zdjęcia będą realizowane w Zduńskiej Woli. Udział w projekcie jest nonprofit.

Jeśli jesteście zainteresowani, podeślijcie mi w wiadomości prywatnej kilka słów o sobie oraz aktualne zdjęcie. 

Więcej informacji o projekcie, rolach i terminach przekażę prywatnie.

Jeśli znacie kogoś, kto mógłby być zainteresowany, będę wdzięczny za udostępnienie.

CASTING CALL — “THE PORTRAIT”
CCA Production 1 Student Short Film

Seeking a male actor for the Photographer.

Preferred playing age: 24–32.

During a portrait session, a photographer and his subject stumble into moments of accidental intimacy. A playful stolen-glasses gag turns their awkward attraction into an intentional connection.

This is a no-dialogue role built around expressive physical acting, comic timing, subtle reactions, and chemistry with the female lead. Blocking will be rehearsed, with room for controlled improvisation.

Shoot dates: November 7–8, 2026
Location: CCA studio, Denver/Aurora area
Commitment: Up to eight hours each shoot day, plus a separate rehearsal scheduled by mutual availability.

Unpaid student production. Lunch and craft services provided.

Director / DP: Jim Burnes
Casting Director / Rehearsal Lead: Mitch Marquez

If interested, please message Jim Burnes with a headshot, reel or recent audition clip if available, and your availability for both shoot days and rehearsal. Script available upon request.

Hi! We’re looking to hire a female actor, acting age 25-40, for an upcoming album cover shoot for a band. The shoot is primarily a still but we will be making some small short video teasers as part of the campaign too, no prep work will be necessary and it will be roughly around 6 hours. The shoot will take place on either the 12th or 13th of October in Sheffield (most likely 13th). We’re looking for someone confident, expressive and comfortable in front of the camera, with a strong presence who can bring character and emotion to the shoot. Previous acting is preferred, with experience in handling small narrative roles. If you’re interested, please get in touch with your relevant information/portfolio/spotlight, DM at @liammaxwellphotos on Instagram or liam@bluevalentineproductions.com

Cheers!

items.text:
Paid Casting Call for a Permanent Main Cast Role in my Miro-Budget Indie Web Series

Evangaline the Black Mage--Main Character Role-long term, Permanently Position.

Pay Rate:

£15 per hour starting from the first hour when we start filming and ending on the last hour when we have stop filming. Overtime payment is included.

Acting Description:

You'll be following my instructions during each Scene/Take as we film. Showing Body Language, Facial Expressions, and Fighting in a RPG gameplay style. You must have a good memory when saying your lines.

Filming Location(s): 

All over Milton Keynes.

The first 2 locations to start us off filming is The Plough Pub in Simpson, follow by The Crauford Arms Pub in Wolverton.

Sometimes outside of Milton Keynes if I can not find a good filming location within the area. And most times film locations need to be specific in the right film set.

How many days of Filming:

Minimal of 1 day per month. I try and do multiple days per month but it get's hard to arrange and organize a Film Date based around everyone's rota's.

Travel Payment:

Your Travel fee(s) will be covered by me coming and going from Milton Keynes but you will have to show some proof of your journey so I can give the right amount to cover your Travels.

Food and Drinks:

Food and Drinks will be provided by me, but I don't bring food and drinks since the Team has been ok bringing there own. If we are near a Local Shop, Café, Coffee Shop, or even a Fast Food Restaurant, ect. Just let me know what you like and I will pay for you.

Evangaline Character Description: 

Full Name: Evangaline Springbell

Age: 19

Class: Black Mage-(Elemental Spellcaster)

Weapon(s): Fans and Rods-(Maybe)

Character Appearance:

She wears a big Leather Brown Wizard Hat with a big Red Ribbon to the side of the Belt Buckle, a Neck Choker, and a smooth Summer Red and Black Tartan Dress with a thin small Black Jacket.

She has Black Leggings with Red and Black Socks on and her hair colour changes sometimes to match her emotions.

Her alternative clothes is a Red and Black Hell Bunny Dress. (DLC idea I have used in the past.)

Character Bio:

Evangaline is a skilful Black Mage who uses Black Magic Spells that are a variety of Elemental and Destructive Power.

She is strong-willed, courageous, and has a strong sense of determination to punish those who commit evil deeds on others with her Black Magic. Even if they are her allies and friends which makes her quite scary.

At times she losses' her cool and get's angry sometimes, losing her temper and casting a Fire Magic Spell on others, especially on Zorran who annoys her and sexualised her for being a good looking woman. Making her very fierce and those who cross her will pay with there life.

she is a bit tomboyish, imposing, sharp-tongued, and extremely blunt, always blurting what she truly thinks and feels like without reservation, even if said comments come at others' expense. She makes it a personal philosophy to always be honest as it feels better.

Relationships with other Main Characters:

(Renzu)---She has a very healthy friendship and respect to Renzu the Main Hero of the Story (Protagonist) after he helped her out for being framed for a crime she did not commit without judging her. Evangaline over time starts to development feelings towards him but still treats him like any other typical Boy as they are the same age and that Evangaline has never spent so much time with a Boy before.

(Zorran)---She doesn't like him all that much for being a drunken, lazy, childish, and perverted older man. When Zorran slaps her bum she sets his hand on fire with a fire magic spell which Zorran never learns from. Evangaline has to keep her guard up around him all the time as Zorran is unpredictable.

(Drako)--She feels Drako's pain after he lost his loved one to a Troll Monster, although Drako hasn't been part of the team for that long and she doe's not know him all too well but she enjoys his fighting spirit and resolve and get's along well with him 2nd to Renzu. Evangaline doe's not get why Drako likes Zorran that much or why his calling him "Master". She thinks he is a bit naïve.

What I'm looking for:

A Female Actress who is Capable, Committed, Not in full Education, Fit for the role, Flexible with her Rota, and is able to travel to Milton Keynes. And can travel to other locations outside Milton Keynes.

Age: 18-24

Height: 5.1 foot to 5.8 foot

Skin: White

Hair Colour: Any.

Body Type: Slim Build, Chubby, Athletic

Acting Requirements: Everybody is welcome, show me what you can do and what you know based on your Acting Experience.

Nationality: White British. Other White or British Nationality are welcome within reason.

I'm willing to let 1 or 2 slide if you don't meet the requirements, the rest will come down to a finale decision as I can't make any mistakes as this role is very important to be filled. If you don't think you can do this or can't handle it then best to step down from applying.

How to apply:

You can send a message to me directly. We can talk first, exchange information and contacts maybe, I will answer some questions that you wish to know or what I have missed in this Casting Call but not too many please as it saves time and I want to save my breath in answering questions and providing more info to those who are actually serious about this Post (No time wasters please).

After a few steps I'LL arrange a time and date to meet face to face with you if you live in or near Milton Keynes or by Video Call if you live far away like London. The chat will be about 1 hour and 30 mins.

If you are traveling to meet me in person your Travel Cost will be covered coming to Milton Keynes and going back home, which I will provide a fair sum for the time you have taken to see me on your journey.

Looking to continue filming with are new Actress as Evangaline ASAP.

Link to my Series on YouTube: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL5A8Ih2U1y15yAfFecmlZ4q_QsdmDLCXT&si=zU8XrRNGpXokHSDY

Thank you for taking the time to read this.

CASTING CALL FOR A MANCHESTER BASED SHORT FILM!!!

Title: Children of the Revolution 

Logline: "Children of the Revolution" is a short film about a group of young rebels who run an underground pirate radio station to oppose a fascist regime. The production will shoot a proof of concept short in Manchester in November and the main short film in spring 2027. 

Casting actors for lead roles in the Revolution Radio team!

Rehearses TBD; shoots three-day proof of concept between Nov. 9 and Nov. 22 in Manchester. Main film shoots in spring 2027 (dates and locations TBD).

We're looking for talent based in Greater Manchester, all acting roles will be unpaid however food and transport costs will be covered by the production.

Roles:

Clash - Mid to late 20s, any ethnicity, male. Clash is the leader of Revolution radio! He dresses like a punk but has a laid back demeanour although he must always remain observant since he's in constant danger.

Roxy - Early 20s to mid 20s, any ethnicity, female. Roxy's the main radio presenter. She's cool, glamorous and knows her 70s stuff while remaining level headed under pressure.

Ziggy - early to mid 20s, any ethnicity, any gender. Ziggy's the tech support of the radio station, they're a nervous nerd that panics at the first sign on trouble so they like to play things safe.

Rex: Early to mid 20s, Rex is the loose cannon of the group. His main role is to drive the rebellious actions of the group and push for change.

If you're interested, please email me at s.a.conlon@edu.salford.ac.uk 

Thank you for considering our film!!!

✨🎄 **CASTING CALL: Theatrical Actors Wanted for a Christmas Enchanted Light Trail** 🎄✨

🎭 **WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**
Engaging, energetic theatrical actors who can hold an audience, improvise with families and bring a character to life under the twinkling lights of our Enchanted Christmas Light Trail at the Sandringham Estate, Norfolk.

📍 **Venue:** Sandringham Estate, Norfolk
📅 **Performance dates:** 18th November - 24th December

items.text:
CHANGING YOUR HAIR FOR ACTING JOBS.

Hey all! I'm an aussie actor and I'm BURNT out trying to navigate the industry here. I'm 5'8 and based in London and I worry that my look is too niche here (or it’s too overpopulated). I've been thinking about going lighter to see if it gets me more work. The light coloured hair is my natural hair but I've always dyed it brown because I thought it suited me better.

I want to be in a period drama, I want to be a villain, I want to be a femme fatale buuuut I can't event book background work in this country. I've been lucky enough to do two commercials. I'm so frustrated that at this point I'm open to anything I can get booked for atm and can't help but think that curly and lighter might help me fit the UK market better.

I would really appreciate your insights, I'm so close to quitting and going into sales x
